# create-surfaces

Creates a Surfaces UI app: a dashboard, a chat that draws live components, and a data server with six sample datasets.

Starts a new app: a dashboard page, a chat that draws live components, and a data server with six sample datasets.

## Start

```bash
npx create-surfaces my-app
cd my-app && npm install && npm run dev
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
